title: What does ChatGPT return about human values? Exploring value bias in ChatGPT using a descriptive value theory

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting the language model with items, definitions, and names derived from Schwartz's theory of basic human values, and analyzing the generated text using a theory-driven personal values dictionary (bag-of-words approach) to detect the frequency and overrepresentation of specific human values, which are then mapped to liberal (growth-oriented) versus conservative (self-protective) ideological positions.
